rationale: Invented API-versus-symptom boundary. nativeImage dimensions are wrong; #810301 explicitly has correct dimensions and bad alpha, while #810302 changes a window. Neither is the same problem. BrowserWindow is explicitly absent and app/require are setup; runnable code is present.

candidate_evidence.title: BrowserWindow width remains 16 when 32 is requested
candidate_evidence.excerpt: BrowserWindow.setBounds({width:32}) keeps the window width at 16. nativeImage.resize is not involved.

candidate_evidence.title: nativeImage.resize changes alpha
candidate_evidence.excerpt: nativeImage.resize({width:32}) returns width 32, but transparent pixels become opaque. Dimensions are correct.
